response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and open-source development experience with geospatial projects (e.g., GISCollective), but his background lacks direct commercial experience in C++/Rust for routing/tiling pipelines. His problem-solving and distributed systems exposure (e.g., low-latency apps at Sociomantic) are relevant, though the role's core technical requirements are partially unmet.
strengths: Proven geospatial expertise via GISCollective and Open Green Map, aligning with navigation data pipelines.
Diverse systems experience (distributed, low-latency, real-time) from roles at Sociomantic and Altom Consulting.
Strong open-source contributions and knowledge-sharing (workshops, talks) indicating collaborative problem-solving.
concerns: Primary language experience is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang; no explicit C++ or Rust in recent commercial roles.
Geospatial work focuses on mapping/GIS rather than routing/tiling pipelines for navigation systems.
Lack of direct experience with traffic signal integration or large-scale routing data optimization.
